source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
At the end of either player's Fight phase, if no models are embarked in this **TRANSPORT**, you may pick 1 **DRUKHARI INFANTRY** unit of yours, wholly within 6" of it, that has no more than 6 models and cannot FLY.

If that unit is outside the Engagement Range of every enemy unit, it may embark in this **TRANSPORT**, even if it already disembarked from a **TRANSPORT** this turn.
